criteria.name: Identity and plan footprint
criteria.evidence: The structural roof ring traces cached Purdue GIS FID 906 to about 0.000002 m. This shows consistency with the source outline used by the model, not independent survey accuracy.

criteria.name: Local frame and structure
criteria.evidence: AssetRoot_walc has identity transform and the detailed asset remains in its local frame. The relative foliage library resolves. The master Placement_walc marker and neighboring context were not checked.

criteria.name: Exterior architecture
criteria.evidence: The overall mass and entrance canopy read as WALC. Added fins improve vertical articulation at the entry, but standard exterior views still show broad repetitive glass ribbons and red-brown bands. Piers, entry depth, facade bays and roof edges remain simplified; roof form and elevations are unverified.

criteria.name: Materials and surface finish
criteria.evidence: Procedural variation and updated glass/bronze responses are assigned. The renders still read as flat dark glazing and uniform red-brown bands, with low-contrast exterior lighting. Paving and entry surroundings are generic.

criteria.name: Interior and program
criteria.evidence: Reading room, atrium, stairs/bridges, stacks, theatre, active-learning classroom and basement are represented. Brighter views improve inspection, but layouts and finishes remain schematic and are not checked against detailed floor plans; the basement is mostly empty.

criteria.name: Reopenability and evidence
criteria.evidence: Exact hash independently reopened in Blender 5.2.3. The relative foliage library resolves, 24 materials are used, the image is packed, and there are no materialless/invalid-slot meshes. No verified elevations, room plans or master placement check were provided.

findings: R2 resolves the machine-specific foliage library path and that relative link succeeds on fresh reopen.
147 bronze facade fins add some vertical rhythm, clearest around the main entry; long horizontal facade bands remain dominant in normal exterior views.
Procedural surface variation is present but not perceptible enough in the saved low-contrast exterior renders to establish convincing masonry/glass texture.
Interior renders are brighter. Existing interior program is substantial but remains generic and unverified against detailed plans.
Near-zero GIS trace residual uses the same cached outline as model input and does not establish surveyed wall accuracy.
Master placement marker and neighborhood composition remain unreviewed.
limitations: No dimensioned as-built facade or roof elevation was found in the reviewed sources.
Floor-by-floor interior room boundaries and finishes remain unverified.
Master Placement_walc and adjacent road/plaza alignment were not part of this standalone review.
GIS residual measures agreement with the cached authored trace, not survey accuracy.
